question: Where is the ITC Sangeet Research Academy located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **ITC Sangeet Research Academy** is located in **Kolkata**.
 
• The academy is renowned for its contribution to Indian classical music, particularly in the field of research and training.
 
• It provides a platform for talented musicians to be trained under the guidance of eminent gurus.
 
• The institution has played a significant role in preserving and promoting the rich heritage of Indian classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ITC Sangeet Research Academy was established in 1977 by ITC Limited, one of India's foremost private sector companies.
 
• The academy follows the ancient 'Gurukul' system where students (scholars) live and learn from their gurus.
 
• It has produced many renowned musicians who have made significant contributions to Indian classical music.
 
• The academy is located in the Tollygunge area of Kolkata, West Bengal.
 
• ITC SRA also organizes concerts, seminars, and workshops to promote Indian classical music.
